page.notes: Woodcut initial "S" stands beside the paragraph "Hæc petitio"; it does not begin a printed word of that paragraph, so it is not joined to the text. Decorative rule above "PRIMA PETITIO." and a bullet mark after "operibus" and a bracket mark beside "Mat.28.19." are not text. A mark "D4" at the bottom right is uncertain and not transcribed. The first line of the page's running head and page number are read at top right; the first word of the thesis "8." has a decorative initial glyph, read as "no-stras" from context. Printing errors left as printed: "strasad" not present; "sanctitas Dei" as printed.
